name: Chris Xrisakis
title: Striker
description: A skinny striker in a red-and-white striped kit with a blue collar. He fights like a through-ball: wait for the lane, then vanish onto it.
source_description: Male fighter, skinny lean build, curly brown hair, red white striped football shirt, blue collar, black necklace, dark eyes.
special_desc: Bursts through the defensive line like a threaded pass.
ultimate_desc: One last surge that hits like a stoppage-time winner.
